name: Siam City Cement Public Company Limited
summary: Siam City Cement Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, imports, exports, and sells cement and cement related products in Thailand, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Singapore, Australia, Cambodia, Bangladesh, Indonesia, India, Dubai, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Cement, Concrete and Aggregate, Waste Management and Industrial Services, Light Building Materials, and Energy. The company offers mortar/dry mixed, concrete, aggregate, superblock, and conwood products; and tile adhesive products, fiber cement for wood replacement products, and light weight autoclaved aerated concrete blocks and panels, as well as ready-mixed concrete and aggregates.
